Low.name: Make room for a small win
Low.desc: Pick one gentle action you can manage right now.
steps: Choose a small action: drink water, open a curtain, or tidy one item.
Do only that one thing. There’s no need to do more.
Notice how it felt to show up for yourself.

Low.name: Make a kinder sentence
Low.desc: Give yourself a little less pressure.
steps: Notice one difficult thought without judging it.
Write what you would say to a friend feeling this way.
Keep one kind sentence for yourself.

Low.name: A comfortable corner
Low.desc: Change one small thing around you.
steps: Choose a place where you feel comfortable.
Adjust one thing: light, sound, or where you sit.
Notice whether this feels supportive. It’s okay if it doesn’t.

Anxious.name: Notice your surroundings
Anxious.desc: Bring your attention to the space around you, at your own pace.
steps: Name three things you can see.
Notice two sounds around you.
Feel one point of contact, like your feet on the floor.

Anxious.name: Sort what is in your hands
Anxious.desc: Give your thoughts a little structure.
steps: Name one thing that is on your mind.
Notice one part you can influence and one you cannot.
Choose a tiny action, or permission to pause.

Anxious.name: Pause the rush
Anxious.desc: Let this moment move at your pace.
steps: Put aside one non-urgent task for a moment.
Notice the support of your chair or the floor.
Decide what you want to return to first.

Okay.name: A moment just for you
Okay.desc: Pause and notice what you need from the rest of your day.
steps: Take a comfortable seat and let your shoulders settle.
Name one thing that would make today a little easier.
Choose one small way to give yourself that support.

Okay.name: Name one need
Okay.desc: Listen to what would support you today.
steps: Choose a word: rest, space, connection, or something else.
Think of one small action that fits that need.
Try it, or write down when you want to try.

Okay.name: Notice something new
Okay.desc: Find a small detail in an ordinary moment.
steps: Look around a familiar space.
Notice one detail you usually overlook.
Write one word or sentence about it.

Good.name: Save something good
Good.desc: Make a little space for something that’s going well.
steps: Name a moment from today that felt good.
Notice what made it meaningful to you.
Write one sentence so you can remember it.

Good.name: Keep a good moment
Good.desc: Save a small memory from today.
steps: Pick something that made you smile.
Name why it mattered to you.
Write a sentence you can revisit.

Good.name: Make time for what you enjoy
Good.desc: Give a little attention to an interest.
steps: Pick an interest you enjoy.
Spend a few minutes with it, or plan a time.
Notice what you enjoyed about that choice.

Great.name: Let the good feeling ripple
Great.desc: Choose a way to carry this feeling into the rest of your day.
steps: Think of one thing you’re grateful for today.
Choose an activity you enjoy, even for a few minutes.
If you want, think of someone you’d like to share it with.

Great.name: Appreciate a connection
Great.desc: Reflect on someone who adds something to your life.
steps: Think of someone you appreciate.
Name one quality or moment you value.
Save a note, or decide whether you want to thank them later.

Great.name: A note to future you
Great.desc: Carry a little of today into another day.
steps: Name what feels good today.
Write one thing you want to remember.
Keep a supportive sentence for your future self.
